correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of facet classes yields singular mass sum w_i^2 and an absolutely continuous mixture over distinct class pairs. Conditional product uniformity along facets yields two uniform and d-2 triangular midpoint-coordinate marginals. Integrals ∫psi=0 and ∫t psi=1/3 isolate each pair weight; for d>=3 positive pairwise products algebraically reconstruct all w_i, whereas for d=2 the conditional density is identically one. The cube TV fractions follow from exact Irwin–Hall polynomial integration. Standalone reproducible simulated 1,320,000 pairs and SymPy rational integration, which supplement (not replace) the proof.

value.rationale: The natural conditioning of midpoint observations to the continuous interior component changes identifiability qualitatively: all planar rectangle aspect ratios become invisible, whereas dimensions >=3 retain every facet-pair probability and orthotope length ratio. Exact bounded finite tensor moments give constructive recovery and a transparent explanation of dimensional rigidity. The rational cube TV examples quantify the difference between conditional and unconditioned surface-chord midpoint sampling; arbitrary slicing or numerical curiosities are not needed.
